- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The implementation plan includes defining requirements, selecting a vendor, configuration and customization, training, testing and QA, and rollout.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Financial plan includes implementation costs, ongoing costs, and expected ROI from improved efficiency and customer satisfaction.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The conclusion emphasizes the investment in TMS will provide significant ROI and improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.
